test_title: PYST 3: SSC GD Constable 2025 - English (Held On: 04 Feb, 2025 - Shift 3)
subject: english
question:
Select the most appropriate option that can substitute the underlined segment in the given sentence.

She __always do__ her work in time.
solution:
The correct answer is '3' i.e. always does .

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The subject of the sentence is "She," which is a third person singular subject.
 
• When using third person singular subjects (he, she, it) in the present simple tense, the verb should have an **-s** on the end.
 
• The verb "do" becomes "does" when used with third person singular subjects.

Correct sentence: *She always **does** her work in time.*

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **Always will done:** This option is grammatically incorrect because "will done" is not a correct verb form.
 
• **Always done:** This option is ungrammatical because "done" is a past participle and cannot function as a main verb without an auxiliary verb.
 
• **Always doing:** This option uses the continuous form of the verb, which does not fit the context of a habitual action.
